title: The operator's words move the belief
problem_line: Same chase and look-alike as PP6. The operator says what to look for: does the route change?

beats.caption: Designated subject in a red shirt and jeans; the drone follows on its own.
Subject lost in the covered walkway. The belief flows north along Oak Street.
A second red shirt jogs out of the far end: two hypotheses, and the route covers both.
Operator: "look for red shirt, jeans". Parsed into clothing words, never sent to a model.
The look-alike wears dark trousers: the belief shifts to the subject's cloud.
Where PP6 turns east after the look-alike, this route stays on the walkway the subject is in.
The subject comes out where the drone is looking; a person confirms.

success_line: The description reached routing only as evidence on the hypotheses, and it changed the route.
